whatsapp_inbound_messages.description: Durable intake of supported and authenticated Meta messages for the configured business number.
whatsapp_inbound_messages.lifecycle: Created before acknowledging the webhook. Redelivery preserves the original row. Processing and retention are release-plan work.

message_id.description: Opaque Meta message identifier used to deduplicate redelivery.

business_phone_id.description: Meta asset identifier of the business number that received the event.

sender_business_id.description: Meta sender identifier scoped to the business portfolio.
sender_business_id.nullMeaning: Meta supplied only the sender phone number.

sender_phone.description: Sender number supplied by Meta to support directory linking and routing.
sender_phone.nullMeaning: Meta supplied a business-scoped sender identifier without a phone number.

occurred_at.description: Timestamp reported by Meta as the message time.

received_at.description: Database timestamp of the first accepted delivery.

content.description: Normalized text, action identifier, media reference or protected verification-code digest consumed by the conversation flow.

conversation_processed_at.description: Time the guided worker completed processing this input and committed its effects.
conversation_processed_at.nullMeaning: The guided worker has not completed this message.

conversation_action.description: Durable identity operation owned by this inbound event.
conversation_action.nullMeaning: There is no outstanding identity operation for the conversation.

conversation_claim_id.description: Unique fence for the worker currently allowed to finalize the identity operation.
conversation_claim_id.nullMeaning: The event has no identity work claim.

conversation_claim_until.description: Time after which another conversation worker may reclaim an unfinished identity operation.
conversation_claim_until.nullMeaning: The event has no active identity work claim.

objects.whatsapp_inbound_messages_pkey: Keeps one accepted event per Meta message ID across retries and concurrent delivery.
objects.whatsapp_inbound_messages_sender_require: Requires at least one sender identifier so a message can be associated with a conversation.
objects.whatsapp_inbound_messages_conversation_c: Requires a complete claim only on an outstanding identity operation and keeps completed events unlocked.
objects.whatsapp_inbound_messages_conversation_i: Supports finding the earliest unprocessed message for one business number.

whatsapp_outbound_messages.description: Durable intent and dispatch evidence for one free-form WhatsApp reply.
whatsapp_outbound_messages.lifecycle: Enqueued before dispatch. Retried only after an explicit provider throttle rejection and while the service window remains open. An unresolved attempt enters UNCERTAIN for reconciliation. Automated retention is release-plan work.

id.description: Caller-assigned immutable UUID for one reply intent and the opaque identifier echoed by Meta on delivery callbacks.

business_phone_id.description: Meta business phone number ID that owns and sends the reply.

payload.description: Immutable destination and validated text or interactive reply content.

state.description: Current queue, provider acceptance or delivery evidence state.

expires_at.description: Last allowed dispatch deadline from the current inbound customer service window.

available_at.description: Earliest eligible time for the next dispatch attempt.

attempt_started_at.description: Most recent claim time used to detect an abandoned dispatch.
attempt_started_at.nullMeaning: The queue has not claimed this reply.

attempts.description: Number of claims recorded before making a provider request.

provider_message_id.description: Meta message identifier returned on acceptance or on a correlated delivery callback.
provider_message_id.nullMeaning: Provider acceptance or delivery has not supplied an identifier.

provider_error_code.description: Integer Graph error code from an explicit rejection or delivery failure.
provider_error_code.nullMeaning: The current evidence has no provider error code.

delivery_status_at.description: Provider timestamp of the accepted delivery status update.
delivery_status_at.nullMeaning: No delivery callback has advanced this reply.

created_at.description: Database timestamp when the reply intent was first enqueued.

objects.whatsapp_outbound_messages_pkey: Prevents another reply intent with the same durable identifier.
objects.whatsapp_outbound_messages_attempts_nonn: Rejects invalid negative dispatch attempt counts.
objects.whatsapp_outbound_messages_provider_key: Correlates delivery by provider message ID within one business phone number and prevents conflicting associations.
objects.whatsapp_outbound_messages_dispatch_idx: Supports finding due messages for a configured sender and tracking current states.

enums.WhatsAppOutboundState: Tracks work from pending and claimed through acceptance, delivery, read, known failure, uncertainty, or service-window expiry.
